mechanics.claim: Kha'Zix gains Unseen Threat whenever the enemy loses sight of him or he activates Void Assault.
mechanics.quote: '''Kha'Zix''' gains ''Unseen Threat'' whenever the enemy loses {{tip|sight}} of him or he activates ''{{ai|Void Assault|Kha'Zix}}''.

mechanics.claim: The bonus damage is dealt only on Kha'Zix's next basic attack against an enemy champion.
mechanics.quote: empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} against an enemy champion to deal

mechanics.claim: The attack's on-hit damage and bonus spell damage are grouped as a single cast instance, so it does not trigger two Electrocute stacks.
mechanics.quote: Both the attack's damage and bonus spell damage are grouped under the same {{tip|cast instance}}.

mechanics.claim: Void Assault grants Unseen Threat even if Kha'Zix never becomes unseen, e.g. under true sight.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Void Assault|Kha'Zix}} grants ''Unseen Threat'' even if '''Kha'Zix''' never becomes unseen (e.g. affected by {{tip|true sight}}).
